summary.zh: 搜索与编辑 Notion 页面、数据库
summary.en: Search and edit Notion pages and databases

description.zh:
连接 Notion 工作区，搜索页面并按需创建或更新内容。
适合把会议记录、知识库与项目资料接入对话。
description.en:
Connect your Notion workspace to search pages and create or update content on demand.
Useful for bringing meeting notes, knowledge bases, and project docs into the conversation.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Notion 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Notion in the browser and authorize on first connect.
